const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    if (_client.chat("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\"}")) |_| {
        return error.TestUnexpectedResult;
    } else |err| { std.debug.print("call failed as expected: {s}\n", .{@errorName(err)}); }
}
